finalLens.deeper_read: You finish the task, then notice another tab, another message, another minor thing that could be made better. That quick turn keeps the hour feeling useful, but it also keeps you just outside it; rest has more room when finished is allowed to stay finished.
finalLens.watch_for: Watch for your hand returning to the phone just after you complete the task in front of you.
finalLens.move: Put the phone out of reach after one task, and leave the next small repair until tomorrow.
